dialogue.origin: (こんにちは、本日はよろしくお願いします時間になったら始めます)
dialogue.content: (Hello, thank you for coming today. We'll start when it's time.)

dialogue.origin: (よろしくお願いします。)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for having me.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員です本日はおいで頂きありがとうございますまずはじめに相談者様の年齢、性別、ご相談の内容をお伝え頂けますか
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 男　担任の先生を変えてほしいです、どうしたらいいですか。
dialogue.content: Male. I'd like to have my homeroom teacher changed. What should I do?

dialogue.origin: 教えて頂きありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: 担任の先生を変えてほしいのですね何かいやなことや困ったことがあったのでしょうかもう少し話すことは可能ですか
dialogue.content: So you'd like to have your homeroom teacher changed. Has something upsetting or difficult happened? Would you be able to tell me a bit more?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: できるところからでいいですよ
dialogue.content: You can start wherever you’re comfortable.

dialogue.origin: 何か良くないことがあると、連帯責任で長い時間説教をしてくる。
dialogue.content: Whenever something bad happens, he lectures us for a long time, holding everyone collectively responsible.

dialogue.origin: こんな感じ
dialogue.content: Something like that.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねそれはいやな気持ちになりますよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must make you feel awful.

dialogue.origin: 来年も同じ先生なので、我慢しないといけないのでしょうか
dialogue.content: He's going to be my teacher next year too. Do I just have to put up with it?

dialogue.origin: 持ち上がりになるのですね
dialogue.content: So he's moving up with your grade.

dialogue.origin: 連帯責任で説教されるとのことですが、ほかにも何かいやなことがありますか
dialogue.content: You mentioned being lectured about collective responsibility. Is there anything else that's bothering you?

dialogue.origin: 我慢できないこととか
dialogue.content: Anything you feel you just can’t tolerate?

dialogue.origin: さっきも言いましたが、来年も同じ担任であること自体が我慢できません
dialogue.content: Like I just said, I can't stand the fact that he'll be my homeroom teacher again next year.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 我慢できないのは、とてもしんどいですよね担任なので毎日顔を合わせると思いますが、顔も見たくない感じですか
dialogue.content: It must be very tough to feel like you can't tolerate it. Since he's your homeroom teacher, I imagine you see him every day. Do you feel like you don't even want to see his face?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 毎日、学校には行っているのですか
dialogue.content: Are you going to school every day?

dialogue.origin: 行ってない時もあります
dialogue.content: There are times when I don’t go.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でもいける時はいっている、という感じですか
dialogue.content: But you go when you can, is that right?

dialogue.origin: まあ一応
dialogue.content: Well, more or less.

dialogue.origin: そんな状況でも学校に行くのは…頑張っているのでしょうねすごいと思いますよ
dialogue.content: Going to school even in that situation... you must be trying very hard. I think that's amazing.

dialogue.origin: ほかの同じクラスの生徒と担任のことを話しますか
dialogue.content: Do you talk with other students in your class about your homeroom teacher?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんなことを話しますか聴かせてもらえますか
dialogue.content: What kinds of things do you talk about? Could you share a bit with me?

dialogue.origin: そちらが質問したことですが
dialogue.content: You're the one who asked.

dialogue.origin: そうですね相談者様が、さきほど連帯責任で説教されるといわれていましたのでそのことについて他の生徒と話したりしているのでは、と思いましたがいかがですか
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. You mentioned earlier that he lectures you about collective responsibility, so I thought you might be talking about that with other students. Is that the case?

dialogue.origin: それがどうかしましたか
dialogue.content: What about it?

dialogue.origin: 我慢できない事を誰かに話したりすれば少しは気持ちが楽になるのでは、と思いました
dialogue.content: I was just thinking that talking to someone about the things you can't tolerate might make you feel a little better.

dialogue.origin: そうだとしたらここに来ていません
dialogue.content: If that were the case, I wouldn’t be here.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 結局我慢するしかないのですか
dialogue.content: So in the end, do I just have to put up with it?

dialogue.origin: 教えて下さってありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様が、我慢して乗り越えられる問題であればいいのでしょうが、そうではないようにおもいます
dialogue.content: It would be one thing if this were a problem you could overcome by enduring it, but it doesn't seem to be the case.

dialogue.origin: クラスの生徒に話すことができないのであれば、ほかに話ができそうな方はいますか親御さんとか、ほかの先生とかはいかがですか
dialogue.content: If you can't talk to the students in your class, is there anyone else you could talk to? How about your parents, or another teacher?

dialogue.origin: 話すことができないなんて言ってないのですが
dialogue.content: I never said I can't talk to them.

dialogue.origin: それに他の先生にも話しましたが、理解してくれません
dialogue.content: Besides, I've already spoken to another teacher, but they don't understand.

dialogue.origin: ほかの先生に話をしても理解してくれないのですねせっかく話をしてもそのような反応だったのですね
dialogue.content: So even when you talked to another teacher, they didn't understand. It must have been disheartening to get that kind of reaction after you opened up.

dialogue.origin: 先生は結局変えられないのでしょうか
dialogue.content: So in the end, the teacher can't be changed?

dialogue.origin: そのことについて、親御さんとは話しましたか
dialogue.content: Have you talked with your parents about that?

dialogue.origin: 話しましたが、結果は同じです
dialogue.content: I have, but the result was the same.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか色々話をしているのにそのような状況で、益々我慢ができなくなりますよねそんな中、いけるときには学校に行く、本当にすごいと思います
dialogue.content: I see. It must be even harder to tolerate the situation when you've tried talking to different people and things haven't changed. And yet, you still go to school when you can. I truly think that's amazing.

dialogue.origin: もう限界です
dialogue.content: I’m at my limit.

dialogue.origin: 限界ですねつらいですね…回りの誰にも気持ちをわかってもらえないとなると世の中で自分誰一人になったような気分になりますよね
dialogue.content: You're at your limit. That's so hard... When no one around you understands how you feel, it can make you feel like you're all alone in the world, can't it?

dialogue.origin: 死んだ方がマシ
dialogue.content: I’d be better off dead.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様は学校には行きたい、と思っていますか
dialogue.content: Do you feel that you want to go to school?

dialogue.origin: わかりません
dialogue.content: I don’t know.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 担任が変わっても学校に行きたいかどうかはわからない感じですか
dialogue.content: So you're not sure if you'd want to go to school even if your homeroom teacher changed?

dialogue.origin: 今は考えられません
dialogue.content: I can’t think about that right now.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 少し先の事を考えてみて…相談者様はこれから先、どのような毎日を送ることができればいいなあと思いますか我慢をし続け、学校に行く以外に何かやってみたいこととかはありますか
dialogue.content: Let's think a little bit about the future... what kind of life would you like to have from now on? Besides continuing to endure this and going to school, is there anything else you'd like to do?

dialogue.origin: 今は考えたくありません
dialogue.content: I don’t want to think about it right now.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね色々我慢してきたので考えたくないのでしょうね
dialogue.content: I see. You've been putting up with so much, it's understandable that you don't want to think about it.

dialogue.origin: 直接、担任の先生本人と話したことはありますか我慢できない、という気持ちをお話ししたことはありましたか
dialogue.content: Have you ever spoken directly with the homeroom teacher himself? Have you ever told him how you feel—that you can't tolerate it?

dialogue.origin: 話しにくいです
dialogue.content: It's hard to talk to him.

dialogue.origin: 話せなくはなさそうですか
dialogue.content: So it's difficult, but maybe not impossible?

dialogue.origin: 話せば変えてもらえるのですか
dialogue.content: If I talk to him, will they change the teacher?

dialogue.origin: 先生が相談者様の話を聴いて感じる事があれば変わるかもしれませんでも変わらないかもしれませんただ、相談者様が先生に伝えたいことがあるのであれば一度話してみてはどうか、と思いました
dialogue.content: If the teacher hears what you have to say and something resonates, he might change. But he might not. Still, if there’s something you want to convey to the teacher, I thought it might be worth trying to talk with him once.

dialogue.origin: 話せないからここに来ているのに結局そうなるのですね
dialogue.content: I came here because I can't talk to him, but in the end, it comes down to that, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: 先ほど、話しにくい、とおっしゃったので先生にお話ししてみよう、と思っていたのかな、と感じました先生に話せないのはなぜなのでしょう余計に説教されそうで面倒くさい感じでしょうか
dialogue.content: A moment ago, you said it was 'hard to talk to him,' which made me feel that you might be thinking of trying to. Why is it that you can't talk to the teacher? Are you worried he might just lecture you more and it would be a hassle?

dialogue.origin: 以前別のことで相談した時に理解してもらえなかったから
dialogue.content: Because I tried talking to him about something else before, and he didn't understand.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でも、今回は理解してもらえるかもしれませんいかがでしょう
dialogue.content: But maybe this time, he might understand. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 残念ながらお時間となってしまいましたので…続きをまたお話に来て頂けますか
dialogue.content: Unfortunately, our time is up... Would you be willing to come back and continue our conversation?

dialogue.origin: 簡単に言わないでくださいもういいですさようなら
dialogue.content: Don't say it so casually. That's enough. Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: 直接お話ししてみる価値はあると思います相談者様はしっかり解決したいと思っていらっしゃるのでしんの強い方だと思っていますそのようにとらえられてしまったのは申し訳なかったです
dialogue.content: I do think it's worth trying to speak with him directly. I believe you're a strong person because you genuinely want to resolve this. I'm sorry it came across that way.

dialogue.origin: 是非またお話に来て下さい
dialogue.content: Please, do come talk with me again.

dialogue.origin: ロープレお疲れ様でした。この後終了の方向でロープレ完了をお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your hard work in the role-play. Please proceed to end the session.)

dialogue.origin: (貴重な体験をありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for this valuable experience.)

dialogue.origin: (終了します、ありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (Ending the session now. Thank you very much.)

topic.sub: 担任の先生とのコミュニケーション問題
